newsitem.title: USA: PremiumWear Q3 results may be below Q2.
newsitem.headline: PremiumWear Q3 results may be below Q2.

text.p: PremiumWear Inc said Friday its third quarter results may fall below the second quarter.

"Overall sales in our industry segment declined in May and June due to unseasonably cool weather in many parts of the country, causing our orders to decline in the quarter," Thomas Gleason, chief executive officer, said in a news release. "As a result, we have cut back production requirements in the third quarter. Consequently, we anticipate that third quarter results may be below those of the second quarter."
The apparel firm earlier Friday reported second quarter sales of $9.2 million and earnings of $287,000, or $0.12 a share.
